en: The image shows a sepia-toned photo of a group of men in traditional Chinese clothing, some holding tools or chains, standing in a line on a street. There are two men in colonial-style pith helmets supervising, and a large road roller is visible in the background. There is a gas street lamp and a tree-lined wall behind the group. The text is in German and runs along the side and bottom of the card.
